# Security Policy

This is a small personal project shared as inspiration. There's no SLA and no formal security team.

If you find a vulnerability, please **report it privately** via GitHub Security Advisories:

→ https://github.com/tuirk/you-are-here/security/advisories/new

That route keeps the report private until a fix is ready. Please don't open a public issue for security problems.

Thanks for taking the time to report responsibly.
